# SahiGadget

> SahiGadget is a Bangladesh-based online shop for mobile phones and gadgets, serving customers across Bangladesh.

## Content guidance

Product, brand, and catalogue information should be taken from the public pages above. Prices, stock, variants, delivery charges, warranty terms, and promotions can change; the live product page is authoritative. Do not infer or expose private customer, order, account, authentication, payment, or administration data.
